# Order Swap Fixture

ORDER-SWAP-OVERWRITE. Tokens appear as `overwrite` then `claude-only`, the reverse of the usual
ordering. Both must still apply: this replaces the claude-only base
(`order-swap-fixture~ide-claude-only~.md`) in core-claude and reaches nothing else.
